picture-pairs.name: Mbica ciĩhuanĩte
picture-pairs.h1: Mbica Ciĩhuanĩte: Ithaako Rĩhoreri rĩa Kũringithania
picture-pairs.description: Mchezo wa bure, mũtũ na wa kũmenyanagĩra kwa andũ akuru na andũ akuru mũno, o hamwe na andũ arĩa maishaga na kũrwara kwa dementia. Picha nĩ ikaguma ĩonekanaga. Gũtarĩ saa ya kũhurĩra wala alama.
picture-pairs.short: Caria mbica igĩrĩ ciĩhuanĩte. Mbica no itũũre cionekete.
picture-pairs.players: Mũndũ 1 kana 2, mariganĩtie mwena kwa mwena
picture-pairs.intro: Hutia mbica ĩmwe, ũcoke ũhutie ĩrĩa ĩhuanĩte nayo. Mbica ciikaraga cionekete o ro ũrĩa kũrĩ, kwoguo gũtĩrĩ kĩndũ kĩrabatara kũririkanwo. Rĩrĩa mbica igĩrĩ ciahana, igĩaga na mũhaka wa rangi wa thahabu hamwe na rũũri rwa gwĩtĩkĩria.
howTo: Thura ũigana wa tubau iria mũkwenda kũhũthĩra. Tubau inya nĩ handũ hega na harĩ thayũ ha kwambĩrĩria.
Hutia mbica o yothe. Nĩĩkũgĩa na mũhaka wa rangi wa thahabu.
Hutia mbica ĩrĩa ĩhaana ta ĩyo. Mbica icio igĩrĩ nĩ ciikaraga hamwe irĩ na rũũri rwa gwĩtĩkĩria.
Angĩkorwo mbica icio igĩrĩ nĩ ngũrani, gũtĩrĩ ũũru o na ũmwe ũkũgĩa. Hutia rĩngĩ rĩrĩa rĩothe ũkwigua wĩhaarĩirie.
Hingũra "Mbica hĩthe" o rĩrĩa tu inywĩ eerĩ mwakenera mũthemba ũcio wa kũhũnja mbica na thĩ.
tips: Gwetai mbica icio na mĩgambo hamwe na mũrie ũhoro wacio: "Gĩkombe gĩkĩ gĩtune gĩa cai. Wee nĩũnyuaga cai na iria?"
Rekereria mũndũ ũrĩa ũrarũmbwiya ahutie mbica, o na angĩkorwo nĩ ũndũ ũkũhũthĩra kahinda. Muonie na kĩara handũ ha kũmũhutĩria.
Tũũrai na tubau inya ihinda rĩrĩa rĩothe mũrĩiguĩte wega. Kũongerera tubau nĩ ũthuri wanyu, ti kĩara kĩrabatara gũkinyĩrwo.
Rĩkĩriai rĩrĩa ithaako rĩrĩ o rĩgĩkenerwo. Ithaako rĩmwe nĩ ũndũ mũiganu biũ.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ kũrĩ na thaa kana ũtari wa marũa?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtĩrĩ thaa, marũa, ũtari wa kũhutia, kana kũhootwo. No mũtige ithaako ihinda o rĩrĩa mũkwenda, na gũtiga gatagatĩ-inĩ nĩ njĩra njega mũno ya kũrĩkĩria.

faq.q: Kĩrĩkĩ gĩtũmaga mbica itũũre cionekete?
faq.a: Gũtũũria mbica cionekete kũgarũraga ithaako rĩkagia rĩa kũrora na kũringithania handũ ha kũririkana. Andũ aingĩ monaga ũndũ ũyũ ũrĩ na thayũ makĩria. No mũcenjie kũrĩ mbica hĩthe o na kũhutia rĩmwe mũngĩenda.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ ya tũhũ, na nĩ ndĩrabatara kwĩyandĩkĩtha?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ ya tũhũ, na gũtĩrĩ akaunti, kwĩyandĩkĩtha kana gũkuha kĩndũ (download). Ĩrutaga wĩra thĩinĩ wa kĩheeni gĩa intaneti (browser) thĩinĩ wa thimũ, tabuleti kana kompiuta.

faq.q: Hihi no tũhũthĩre mbica citũ cia famĩlĩ?
faq.a: Ĩĩ. Gerai Photo pairs, ĩrĩa ĩmũrekagĩrĩria gũthura mbica kuuma thĩinĩ wa kĩhũthĩro kĩanyu. Mbica ciikaraga o thĩinĩ wa browser yanyu na ititũmagwo handũ hangĩ.

find-the-same.name: Caria ĩrĩa ĩhuanĩte
find-the-same.seoTitle: Tĩra Picha Ĩrĩa Ĩhanaga: Mchezo Mwega wa Picha
find-the-same.description: Picha ĩmwe igũrũ, nayo ĩrĩ ĩrĩ mbere kuuma kĩĩrĩa kĩrĩ hakuhĩ na nne. Kũgũrũgũria ĩrĩa ĩhanaga. Mchezo wa picha wa bure, mũtũ, wa andũ akuru, andũ akuru mũno na famĩlia, ũtarĩ saa ya kũhurĩra.
find-the-same.short: Rora mbica ĩrĩa ĩrĩ igũrũ ũcoke ũhutie ĩrĩa ĩhaana nayo rungu.
find-the-same.intro: Mbica ĩmwe ĩikaraga igũrũ rĩa kĩrorero. Rungu rwayo he mbica igĩrĩ, ithatũ kana inya. Hutia ĩrĩa ĩhuanĩte nayo. Nĩ ũthuri ũmwe mũhũthũ ihinda o rĩmwe, ũrĩ na mweke mwega mũno wa kwaranĩria.
howTo: Thura mbica igĩrĩ, ithatũ kana inya cia gũthurĩra kwo. Mbica igĩrĩ nĩcio hũthũ makĩria.
Rorai mbica ĩrĩa ĩrĩ igũrũ hamwe.
Hutia mbica ĩyo ĩhuanĩte nayo rungu. Nĩĩkũgĩa na rũũri rwa gwĩtĩkĩria na ciugo nini cia kwendana.
Angĩkorwo mbica ĩngĩ ngũrani nĩyahutio, ithaako nĩrĩgweta o rĩĩtwa rwayo na rĩetereire. Hoyai ihinda rĩanyu wega.
Hutia "Mbica ĩrĩa ĩrũmĩrĩire" rĩrĩa mũkũigua mwĩhaarĩirie kũgĩa na ĩngĩ.
tips: Arai ũhoro wa o mbica mbere ya gũthura: rangi, mĩhianĩre yayo, na kũrĩa mũngĩmĩona.
Gũthura gatagatĩ-inĩ ka mbica igĩrĩ ti ũndũ "mũhũthũ mũno". Muoroto nĩ kũgĩa na ihinda rĩega rĩa gĩkeno, ti kũgerio.
Angĩkorwo kũhutia nĩ kũritũ, mũndũ ũcio no arute kĩara nawe ũmũhutĩrie.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ kũrĩ na thaa kana ũtari wa marũa?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtĩrĩ thaa, marũa, ũtari wa kũhutia, kana kũhootwo. No mũtige ithaako ihinda o rĩrĩa mũkwenda, na gũtiga gatagatĩ-inĩ nĩ njĩra njega mũno ya kũrĩkĩria.

faq.q: Gũkĩgĩaga atĩa angĩkorwo mbica ĩrĩa ĩtagĩrĩire nĩyahutio?
faq.a: Gũtĩrĩ ũũru o na ũmwe ũkũgĩa. Gũtĩrĩ mũgambo wa kũrigariga, mũthalaba mũtune, kana kũinaina. Ithaako nĩrĩgweta rĩĩtwa rĩa mbica ĩrĩa yahutio na rĩgeterera kũhutio kũngĩ.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ ya tũhũ, na nĩ ndĩrabatara kwĩyandĩkĩtha?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ ya tũhũ, na gũtĩrĩ akaunti, kwĩyandĩkĩtha kana gũkuha kĩndũ (download). Ĩrutaga wĩra thĩinĩ wa kĩheeni gĩa intaneti (browser) thĩinĩ wa thimũ, tabuleti kana kompiuta.

shadow-match.name: Kũringithania kĩruru
shadow-match.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Kũmenyanagĩra Mĩthingo: Wa Bure Interineti kwa Andũ Akuru
shadow-match.h1: Kũringithania Kĩruru: Ithaako Rĩhoreri rĩa Mbica
shadow-match.description: Mĩthingo mĩnene igũrũ, nayo mĩthingo mĩrĩ ĩrĩ mbere kuuma kĩĩrĩa kĩrĩ hakuhĩ na nne. Kũgũrũgũria picha ĩrĩa ĩtũmaga mĩthingo ĩu. Mchezo wa bure, mũtũ wa kũmenyanagĩra mĩthingo, ũtarĩ saa ya kũhurĩra.
shadow-match.short: Rora kĩruru ũcoke ũhutie mbica ĩrĩa ĩrakĩrehe.
shadow-match.intro: Kũringithania kĩruru nĩ ithaako rĩũĩkaine kuuma maratathi-inĩ marĩa macabĩtwo, no haha rĩrĩ na mbica nene na gũtĩrĩ kĩndũ kĩrabatara gũcabwo. Kĩruru kĩororo kĩikaraga igũrũ rĩa kĩrorero na mbica igĩrĩ, ithatũ kana inya iketerera rungu. Hutia ĩrĩa ĩratũma kĩruru kĩu kĩgĩe. Mĩhianĩre ta baisikiri, thambũreria, kana gĩkombe gĩa cai nĩ mĩhũthũ gũteterwo nĩ ũhoro o nayo.
howTo: Thura mbica igĩrĩ, ithatũ kana inya cia gũthurĩra kwo. Mbica igĩrĩ nĩcio hũthũ makĩria.
Rorai kĩruru kĩu hamwe. Kĩhaana atĩa? Nĩ kĩraihu kana nĩ gĩthiũrũrũke?
Hutia mbica ĩrĩa ĩratũma kĩruru kĩu kĩgĩe. Rĩĩtwa rwayo nĩ rĩoneke rungu rwa kĩruru.
Angĩkorwo mbica ĩngĩ ngũrani nĩyahutio, ithaako nĩrĩgweta o rĩĩtwa rwayo na rĩetereire. Hoyai ihinda rĩanyu wega.
Hutia "Kĩruru kĩrĩa gĩkũrũmĩrĩra" rĩrĩa mũkũigua mwĩhaarĩirie kũgĩa na kĩngĩ.
tips: Thingĩrĩriai mĩhaka ya kĩruru na kĩara na mwarĩrie ũrĩa gĩhaana.
Angĩkorwo makĩruru nĩ maroneka maritũ ũmũthĩ, cenjiai mũthiĩ kũrĩ Caria ĩrĩa ĩhuanĩte, kũrĩa mbica ciĩhuanĩte.
Arai ũhoro wa mbica ĩyo rĩrĩa yoneka: "Twarĩ na thambũreria ĩhaana ta ĩyo."

faq.q: Hihi nĩ kũrĩ na thaa kana ũtari wa marũa?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtĩrĩ thaa, marũa, ũtari wa kũhutia, kana kũhootwo. No mũtige ithaako ihinda o rĩrĩa mũkwenda, na gũtiga gatagatĩ-inĩ nĩ njĩra njega mũno ya kũrĩkĩria.

faq.q: Andũ arĩa maishaga na kũrwara kwa dementia no mekenagĩre mchezo wa kũmenyanagĩra mĩthingo?
faq.a: Andũ aingĩ mekenagĩra, o hamwe na andũ amwe arĩa maishaga na kũrwara kwa dementia, hakuhĩ ha ciikaro cia mbere. Mĩrĩ nĩ ĩrahĩtagwo kũmenyerera gũkĩra maneno. Nĩ wa kũgwĩkia na kũhaana ũhoro, tiri wa kũgerera, na tiguo wa kũhonia kana kũhunyũka dementia. Angĩkorwo nĩ ũtũmaga ũkaiga, geria Tĩra ĩrĩa ihanaga kana ũrore picha hamwe na mwana wa mũndũ.

faq.q: Gũkaga atĩa mbica ĩrĩa ĩtagĩrĩire yahinyĩrĩrio?
faq.a: Gũtirĩ ũndũ mũru wokaga. Gũtirĩ mũgambo wa kũhũũra, mũtharaba mũtune, kana kũinaina gwa kĩara. Ithako nĩ rĩĩtaga rĩĩtwa rĩa mbica ĩrĩa yahinyĩrĩrio na rĩgeterera kũhinyĩrĩrio rĩngĩ.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ ya kũhũthĩra tũhũ, na nĩ ngũbatara kwĩyandĩkithia?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ ya kũhũthĩra tũhũ, na gũtirĩ akaunti, kwĩyandĩkithia, kana kũbuthũra kĩndũ. Ĩrutaga wĩra thĩinĩ wa web browser thĩinĩ wa thimũ, tablet, kana kompiuta.

four-together.name: Ana hamwe
four-together.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Kũgwĩkanya Picha kwa Andũ Akuru: Ana Hamwe
four-together.h1: Ana Hamwe: Mchezo Mũtũ wa Kũgwĩkanya Picha
four-together.description: Some of the pictures share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the ones that go together. A free, calm grouping game with no timer and no score.
four-together.short: Tĩra picha ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hamwe, ta matunda kana mbeũ.
four-together.intro: Kĩrĩ kĩnini kĩa picha, nayo imwe ĩrĩ hamwe: matunda ma mĩrĩ mana, kana njĩra ina cia gũthiĩ. Kũgũrũgũria picha ĩrĩa ĩgerera kĩĩgiro kĩmwe. Angĩkorwo picha ĩrĩ na kĩndũ kingĩ, mchezo nĩguoya ũmenyeke na ũtegerere. Kwa wakanya mũhutu, ĩhinda rĩmwe mĩrĩ nĩĩ ĩgwĩkanyĩrĩra kĩĩgiro, na "Onia kĩĩgiro" nĩgwonia ũhoro wothe ĩhinda ĩrĩa ũrenda.
howTo: Tĩra picha ina, sita kana nane. Ina nĩyo ĩrahĩtagwo, ĩrĩ na itatũ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hamwe.
Rorai picha hamwe na mwĩrage ĩndũ ĩrĩa ihanaga.
Kũgũrũgũria picha ĩrĩa ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro. Nĩĩgũtwarwo ruhiu rwa dhahabu na alama ya kũgwĩkanya.
Angĩkorwo picha ĩrĩ na kĩndũ kingĩ, mchezo nĩguoya ũmenyeke na ũtegerere. Tũmĩra ũkare wanyu.
Kũgũrũgũria "Onia kĩĩgiro" ĩhinda rĩrĩa ũrenda, ũmwe "Kĩĩgiro kĩngĩ" kwa picha ingĩ.
tips: Wĩra ũndũ ũrĩa woonaga ũraraga: "Ĩno ĩrĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mbeũ ya kĩrio."
Gũtarĩ harĩ gũthiĩrĩra. Ĩhinda rĩmwe mĩrĩ nĩ ĩgwĩkanyĩrĩra kĩĩgiro, ũkaaga kũyirĩra.
Ragwo ũhoro wa kĩĩgiro kĩrĩ gwakĩrĩrwo: matunda ũrenda, safari ya mwanya, hali ya mbura ĩno.

faq.q: Kũrĩ saa ya kũhurĩra kana alama?
faq.a: Tiguo. Gũtarĩ saa, alama, kũrarũa kwa hatua wala gũthiĩra. Ũngĩ ũthiĩ ĩhinda ĩrĩa ũrenda, na kũthiĩra ũkiri hakati nĩ ũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩ mwega wa kwĩmalĩrĩra.

faq.q: Kĩrĩ gĩkaguo angĩkorwo picha ĩtariĩ kĩĩgiro gĩgĩgũrũgũrĩrwo?
faq.a: Tiguo ũndũ mũũru. Gũtarĩ rĩtũ, ruhiu rwa mũthanga kana gwĩgũrũka. Mchezo nĩguoya picha, ũgwake ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro kĩngĩ, na ũtegerere kĩgũrũgũrio kĩngĩ.

faq.q: Makĩĩgiro ni marĩkũ?
faq.a: Mĩhoro ya kwa mũthenya itarĩ ũũi wa mũhĩrĩ: matunda, nyamu, marua, mbura, njĩra cia gũthiĩ, ndũ cia kũnyua cahu gĩthaka na ndũ cia kũgĩrĩrwo thanũrũ. Picha ĩmwe ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro kĩmwe gũkeya.

faq.q: Nĩ wa bure, na nĩ ũkwenda kwandĩkwo?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ wa bure, na gũtarĩ akaunti, kwandĩkwo wala kũoya. Nĩ ũtũmaga kuuma kĩvinjari kĩa wavuti kwa simu, tabuleti kana kompiuta.

odd-one-out.name: Ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ kĩĩgiro
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Picha wa Ĩrĩa Ĩtarĩ Kĩĩgiro kwa Andũ Akuru
odd-one-out.h1: Ĩrĩa Ĩtarĩ Kĩĩgiro: Mchezo Mũtũ wa Picha
odd-one-out.description: Picha itatũ kana ina, nayo ĩrĩa ĩrĩ ĩmwe gũkeya ĩrĩ na kĩĩgiro kĩmwe, ta matunda kana mbeũ. Kũgũrũgũria ĩrĩa itarĩ kĩĩgiro. Ĩrĩ wa bure, mũtũ, ũtarĩ saa wala alama.
odd-one-out.short: Tĩra picha ĩrĩa itarĩ kĩĩgiro hamwe na ingĩ.

Kwa wakanya mũhutu, ĩhinda rĩmwe mĩrĩ nĩĩ ĩgwĩkanyĩrĩra ĩrĩa ingĩ ĩrĩ hamwe, na "Onia" nĩgwonia ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ kĩĩgiro ĩhinda ĩrĩa ũrenda.

Angĩkorwo picha ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro na ingĩ, mchezo nĩguoya ũmenyeke na ũtegerere. Tũmĩra ũkare wanyu.

Picha yoothe ĩrĩ mwanya mwega wa gwĩkanĩria: matunda ũrenda, gũthiĩ gathaka, mwanya wa mbura.

faq.q: Kĩrĩ gĩkaguo angĩkorwo picha ĩrĩa ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro gĩgĩgũrũgũrĩrwo?
faq.a: Tiguo ũndũ mũũru. Gũtarĩ rĩtũ, ruhiu rwa mũthanga kana gwĩgũrũka. Mchezo nĩguoya picha, ũgwake ĩrĩ kĩĩgiro na ingĩ, na ũtegerere kĩgũrũgũrio kĩngĩ.

faq.q: Picha ĩtarĩ kĩĩgiro ĩteuo atĩa?
faq.a: Picha ciumaga mĩhoro ya kwa mũthenya itarĩ ũũi wa mũhĩrĩ: matunda, nyamu, marua, mbura, njĩra cia gũthiĩ, ndũ cia kũnyua cahu gĩthaka na ndũ cia kũgĩrĩrwo thanũrũ. Picha ĩmwe ĩrĩ ĩhoro ĩmwe gũkeya, nayo ĩtarĩ kĩĩgiro ihaandĩka kuuma ĩhoro ĩngĩ.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

color-match.name: Color match
color-match.seoTitle: Color Match: a Gentle Picture Game
color-match.h1: Color Match: Find the Pictures of One Color
color-match.description: A large color with its name, and four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color. No timer, no score, and another color is simply named. Free to play and print.
color-match.short: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.
color-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
color-match.intro: A large patch of color is shown with its name written beside it, and below it are four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color: a red apple and a red cup, for example. If a picture is another color, the game simply names it ("The pear is green.") and waits. "Show them" points out the pictures that match at any time, and "Another color" moves on.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Look at the color and read its name together.
Tap every picture that is that color. Each one gets a thick border and a check mark.
If a picture is another color, the game says what color it is and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show them" whenever you like, then "Another color" for a new color.
tips: Say the color out loud, then look around the room: what else is that color?
Use your own words if you like. "Tomato" or "sky" is as good as "red" or "blue".
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture of another color is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture and its color, such as "The pear is green.", and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: Is color the only clue?
faq.a: No. The color is shown as a large patch and also written as a word, and every picture is named when it is tapped. Someone who finds a color hard to see can still play by reading the name.

faq.q: Is every picture really that color?
faq.a: The pictures are chosen by hand, and only ones where the main object is plainly one color. Pictures with several colors, such as a kite or a bee, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has four rows. Each row names a color and shows four pictures to point to or circle.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

halves-match.name: Halves match
halves-match.seoTitle: Halves Match: a Gentle Picture Game
halves-match.h1: Halves Match: Join the Two Halves of a Picture
halves-match.description: The left halves of two or three pictures on one side, their right halves on the other. Tap a half, then the half that fits it. No timer, no score, and halves that do not fit simply separate. Free to play and print.
halves-match.short: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.
halves-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
halves-match.intro: Each picture is cut down the middle. The left halves of two or three pictures are in one column and their right halves, in a different order, are in the other. Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it, such as the spout of a kettle and its handle. Halves that fit are joined into a whole picture. Halves that do not fit simply separate again, and the game says so gently. "Show me" joins them all.
howTo: Choose two or three pictures. Two is the simplest.
Look at the left halves together. What do you think each one is part of?
Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it. It also works the other way round.
Halves that fit are joined, with a thick border and a check mark. Halves that do not fit separate again, and you can try another.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Trace the edge of a half with a finger. Where does the drawing reach the middle?
Say what you can see: "That one has a handle." There is no need to name every picture.
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if two halves do not fit?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The two halves separate again and the game says, "Those two do not fit together. Try another." Nothing is counted.

faq.q: Are the pictures easy to tell apart?
faq.a: Yes. The pictures are chosen by hand, and two pictures on one board are never from the same group, such as two fruits or two animals. Pictures whose two halves look alike, such as the sun or a rainbow, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Ee. Rũtaro rũmwe rũrĩ na tũcunjo twa mĩthĩĩ ithatũ tũrĩ kũrũ kwa mũtiro ũmwe, na tũcunjo tw'iyo ithatũ tũrĩ mũtiro ũria ũngĩ, tũrĩ na ũhoro ũngĩ. Ũtaro tũcunjo twa mũthĩĩ ũhoro ũrĩa twĩrĩtagia na ũtwĩrĩtie.

faq.q: Ni bure, na nĩ ngũĩtaga kwĩandikĩshĩa?
faq.a: Ee, ni bure, na gũtarĩ akaunti, kwĩandikĩshĩa kana kũrota. Nĩ ũhoro ũgwĩka kĩrĩ kĩrĩ web browser kĩrĩa kĩrĩ foni, tablet kana kompyuta.

color-by-number.name: Color by number
color-by-number.seoTitle: Color by Number: Mũtambo wa Kũrũta Rangi Ũrĩa Ũrĩ Mũthenya, Ũrĩa Mũnene wa Mĩrũgamo
color-by-number.h1: Color by Number: Rũta Mĩraba, Rangi Ũrĩa Ũkenda
color-by-number.description: Ũmenyeri wa mĩraba mĩnene ĩrĩ na namba, na gĩtabũ kĩrĩ na rangi nne na mĩena yayo. Thura rangi, ĩndĩ ũgakĩa mĩraba ũrute. Rangi yoso nĩ ũhoro, gũtarĩ saa wala mĩhaha, na kitufe kĩrĩ rũta mĩraba ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ rangi kĩrĩ namba. Nĩ bure gũthaithania na gũcapa.
color-by-number.short: Thura rangi, ĩndĩ ũgakĩa mĩraba ĩrĩ na namba ũrute.
color-by-number.intro: Ũmenyeri wa mĩraba mĩnene, o mũraba ũrĩ na namba, na gĩtabũ kĩrĩ juu yayo kĩrĩ na rangi nne, o rangi ĩrĩ na namba yayo na rĩĩtwa ryayo rĩandikĩtwo. Thura rangi kuuma gĩtabũ-ini, ĩndĩ ũgakĩa mĩraba ũrute. Ũmenyeri nĩ 4 na 4 mwanzo, na 6 na 6 kana 8 na 8 wakenda mĩraba mĩingĩ. Mĩraba yothe ĩrĩ rangi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na namba yayo ĩgeeka, ũmenyeri nĩ ũrĩa ũrĩ kũrũ kwa rũkarata. Mĩraba ĩrĩ rangi ingĩ ĩngĩ nĩ ũrĩa wĩrutĩte wega, na mchezo ndũkaiga ũhoro wayo. "Rũta na namba" nĩ kũrũta mĩraba yothe ĩtarĩ rangi.
howTo: Thura ũrĩa ũmenyeri ũrĩ mũnene. 4 na 4 nĩ mĩraba mĩnene mũno na nĩ ũrĩa mwega mũno.
Rora gĩtabũ kĩrĩ juu ya ũmenyeri. Rangi yoso ĩrĩ na namba na rĩĩtwa, kũrĩ ta 1 Yellow.
Kanda rangi gĩtabũ-ini, ĩndĩ ukande mĩraba ũrĩa ũkenda kũrutana nayo.
Tumia rangi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ namba, kana rangi ũrĩa ũkenda. Ciothe nĩ ciega.
Kanda "Rũta na namba" nĩ mĩraba ĩtarĩ rangi, "Futa" nĩ kũmbĩrĩria ũmenyeri ũngĩ, kana "Mũtaro mũngĩ" nĩ mũtaro ũngĩ.
tips: Icarai mũcemanĩre, mũhaana: mũndũ ũmwe athure rangi, ũngĩ akande mũraba.
Iga ũhoro wa rangi: "Nenda rangi ya mũthenya." Gũtarĩ ũhitaji wa kwaria ũhoro wa mũtaro.
Kĩrĩa kĩrĩ screen nyembamba, ũmenyeri wa 8 na 8 nĩ ũgũthiĩ ũkĩ mũrĩ sanduku yawo. Mĩraba nĩ mĩnene ũrĩa ũrĩ mwega.
Rũta rũrĩ rũrĩa rwa mpapura nĩ rũgwĩka o ta, na penseli mezani kwa kitanda.

faq.q: Kũrĩ saa kana mĩhaha?
faq.a: Tiyo. Gũtarĩ saa, mĩhaha, kũbara mĩgiro wala gũtshindwa. Nĩ ũrĩ ũgeetĩkaga rĩrĩa wenda, na gũkĩa kĩrĩ katĩ nĩ ũhoro mwega wa kũmaliza.

faq.q: Nĩ kĩ kĩrĩ ngĩ ndaarĩ rangi ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ namba?
faq.a: Gũtarĩ kĩrĩa gĩkaaga, na kĩo nĩ kĩo kĩrĩ ũhoro. Rangi yoso nĩ ũgwĩka mũraba wowote, na mchezo ndũkaiga ũhoro wayo. Mĩraba yothe ĩrĩ rangi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ namba yayo, mchezo wagĩra gũkaaga na ũtenyane. Ũmenyeri wa rangi ciaku mwene nawo nĩ ũhoro o ta.

faq.q: Andũ arĩa baamba kwona rangi gũkaaga, mantũ nĩ marĩ rangi ĩrĩa nne ĩrĩ ũmwe?
faq.a: Nĩ thuurwo ĩrĩ ũrĩ. Rangi yoso ĩrĩ na namba, rĩĩtwa rĩandikĩtwo, na ndoa yayo nini, kwa hinya rangi ndĩ ĩrĩ ũhoro ũmwe wa gũthithia. Rangi nne nĩ ciarĩ kũrorwo kwa mĩĩrĩre ya red-green na blue-yellow, na ciathanana na ũtũkũ. Mũndũ ũrĩ na ũmaramũ wa rangi ndaragerĩra, nĩ ũtwĩre ũngĩ kana rangi ĩrĩ ĩmwe ĩrĩ ta ĩngĩ.

faq.q: Mĩraba nĩ mĩnene ũrĩa ũrĩ mwega kũrĩ mũndũ ũrĩ na kũtetemeka kana screen nini?
faq.a: O mũraba nĩ ũrĩ na pixels 48 ũgeretie, na 56 kũrĩ ũmenyeri wa 4 na 4. Kĩrĩa ũmenyeri ũrĩ mũnene mũno kũrĩ screen, nĩ ũgũthiĩ ũkĩ mũrĩ sanduku yawo, ndĩ mĩraba ndĩgaka nyiinyĩa.

faq.q: Nĩ kũrĩ rũta rwa mpapura?
faq.a: Ee. Rũgerũ rũmwe rwa mpapura rũrĩ na ũmenyeri wa namba na gĩtabũ kĩrĩ na rangi nne na rĩĩtwa ryayo. Rũta mũraba o wothe na penseli ĩrĩ rangi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ namba yayo, kana rangi ũrĩa ũkenda.

faq.q: Ni bure, na nĩ ngũĩtaga kwĩandikĩshĩa?
faq.a: Ee, ni bure, na gũtarĩ akaunti, kwĩandikĩshĩa kana kũrota. Nĩ ũhoro ũgwĩka kĩrĩ web browser kĩrĩa kĩrĩ foni, tablet kana kompyuta.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern maker
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Maker: Rũta Tile na Ũrute Mũthiũrĩre
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Maker: Rũta Tile, Ũrone ĩkaraanĩa
pattern-maker.description: Hindĩrĩria mĩraba ya tile ĩmwe nini, ũrore ĩkaraanĩa ĩkĩ mũthiũrĩre, na rangi nne o yoso ĩrĩ na rĩĩtwa na ndoa yayo. Gũtarĩ saa wala mĩhaha. Nĩ bure gũthaithania na gũcapa.
pattern-maker.short: Hindĩrĩria mĩraba ya tile nini, ũrore ĩkaraanĩa ĩkĩ mũthiũrĩre.
pattern-maker.intro: Tile nini ya mĩraba 3 na 3, kana 4 na 4 kũrĩa wenda, na mũcemanĩre wayo "ũthiũrĩre waku": tile ĩyo ĩrĩa ĩkaraanĩtwo mũthiũrĩre. Kanda mũraba ũgeeka ũkĩ rangi ĩrĩa ĩngĩ kuuma kĩrĩa nne, o yoso ĩrĩ na rĩĩtwa na ndoa yayo. Ũthiũrĩre ũrĩa ũrĩ mũcemanĩre nĩ ũgeeka rĩu rĩu. Gũtarĩ ũthiũrĩre wa kũgĩrĩra, na gũtarĩ kĩndũ gĩtũrĩtwo kana gĩtũmwa. "Ta ũthiũrĩre wakwa" nĩ kũrũta ũthiũrĩre ũrĩa ũkaraanĩtwo mpapurĩ ĩmwe, ũkĩ kũrĩ kũbiga, kũrĩa rangi, kana kũĩha.
howTo: Ona tile na ũthiũrĩre waku ũrĩ mũcemanĩre. Ni tile ĩmwe, ĩkaraanĩtwo.
Kanda mũraba. Ũgeeka rangi ĩrĩa ĩngĩ mũrĩ mũtiro wa rangi nne ũrĩ kũrũ.
Endelea kũkanda mĩraba nginya ũthiũrĩre ũrĩ ta ũrĩa wenda. Ũthiũrĩre o wowote nĩ mwega.
Kanda "Nindĩrĩria ũrĩa mũhaana" nĩ tile ĩngĩ, kana "Tandĩka rĩngĩ" nĩ tile ĩtarĩ kĩndũ. "Ĩcookia" nĩ kũgarũra tile ĩrĩa wari naĩyo.
Kanda "Ta ũthiũrĩre wakwa" wenda ũgũrũte mpapurĩ, kana kanda Rest kũgĩrĩra.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.q: Is there a winner or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, no score, no timer and no count of turns. There is no right picture, and nothing is ranked or compared.

faq.q: Is the picture saved or sent?
faq.a: No, nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this page until you close it. If you tap Save picture, a file is made on your device for you to download. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I take back a line?
faq.a: Yes. "Take back my last line" removes the newest line of the person whose turn it is. "Start again" clears the sheet, and "Put it back" brings the lines back, one step only.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the drawing has focus, the arrow keys move a pen dot, and the Space key puts the pen down or up. The screen says "Pen down" or "Pen up" each time.

faq.q: What colors are they, and can people with color-blindness tell them apart?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the names show beside the turn. The colors were checked with simulations of common color-vision differences, but a person with color-vision differences has not yet tried them.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the paper version" prints one sheet with the rules on it and a large blank frame to draw in, for two people with two pens. It works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ee, nĩ ũhoro wa bure, na gũtarĩ akaunti, gũiyandikia kana gũkuua. Ũrahota kũmakĩrwo webũ-brauza ya thimũ, tebuleti kana kompiuta.

build-together.name: Kwaka hamwe
build-together.seoTitle: Kwaka Hamwe: Andũ Eerì Mao Mũtiitũ Ũmwe
build-together.h1: Kwaka Hamwe: Andũ Eerì, Gridi Ĩmwe
build-together.description: Andũ eerì makwaria kwĩnja mũthinji ũmwe mũgridi ya hamwe nginya ũiyure, o mũndũ akiwe rangi yake ĩrĩ ĩrĩtwa na mũcoro. Gutarĩ ũrĩa ũgatoranga, na gutarĩ saa wala mbaara. Ni wa bure kũgwĩrĩra na kũgĩrũkia.
build-together.short: Ruga na mũndũ ũrĩ handũ hamwe ũiyurie gridi ĩmwe ya hamwe.
build-together.intro: Gridi ya hamwe ya ndirikoni 4 na 4, kana 3 na 3 angĩ wenda. O mũndũ wanyu agwaathania rangi, na rangi o ĩmwe ina rĩtwa rĩayo rĩandĩkĩtwo na mũcoro wayo. Mũrugaga: rĩu nĩ rĩao, gwĩnja ndirikoni ĩrĩa itarĩ kĩndũ, nĩguo mũgwĩnje mũthinji wanyu. Ndirikoni ĩrĩ na mũthinji ti ĩrĩa ĩgwĩtwo nĩ mũndũ ũmwe. Ũrĩ mũthinji ũgaakĩa, mũtiitũ ũkaaka hamwe. Gutarĩ ũrĩa ũgatoranga, nĩ gũkĩ mũakaaka ta andũ eerì, na gutarĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩgaigwo kana kĩgatumwo. "Ĩrĩgiria gridi" ĩrigĩrĩrĩra gridi ĩtarĩ kĩndũ rĩrĩa ĩrĩ harĩ rũrĩrĩ rũmwe nĩguo mwake na mĩthingo ĩĩrĩ.
howTo: O mũndũ wanyu agwaathania rangi. Rangi ĩrĩa mũndũ ũngĩ ũrĩ nayo ĩgaaonania ĩrĩ "Ĩrĩ gũtumikwo".
Mũndũ wa mbere nĩye ũrĩkĩrĩra. Kiĩrĩgiro kĩraa ũrĩa mũtugo wa mũndũ ũrĩkĩrĩra ya rangi yake.
Gwaathania ndirikoni ĩtarĩ kĩndũ nĩguo ũike mũthinji waku harĩ. Mũtugo ũhinduka gũkĩrwo nĩ mũndũ ũngĩ.
Ũngĩenda gũtiga gũika mũthinji, gwaathania "Thiĩ". O mũndũ wanyu ũngĩ kũthiĩ rĩrĩ rĩrĩa mũgwenda.
Rĩrĩa ndirikoni yothe ĩrĩ na mũthinji, nĩmwakaaka mũtiitũ hamwe. Gwaathania "Taanga rĩngĩ" nĩguo mwake ũngĩ, kana gwaathania Ruo nĩguo mũreke.
tips: Tũũrai handũ hamwe nĩguo mũone na mũgwenjũke skrini. Ĩrĩa mũgwĩnja, ũgwĩre: "Nĩngwĩka wakwa harĩ waku."
Geria gwaka mũtiitũ, mĩtũ ya rangi, kana mũthinji wa mĩrĩ, kana gwĩka mũthinji harĩ kũrĩa mwendete. Ĩgiriria ciothe nĩ njega.
Mũana kana mũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩ na mũhumo mũingĩ, nĩ ũngĩthiĩ rĩrĩa angĩenda. Mũtiitũ ũrĩ ũkaakwo hamwe.
Harĩ rũrĩrĩ, mũndũ o mũmwe athĩnjagĩra ikaramu imwe na akahuthia mũthinji wake harĩ ndirikoni ĩtarĩ kĩndũ.

faq.q: Kũrĩ mũnene, saa kana mbaara?
faq.a: Aca. Gutarĩ mũnene, tondũ mũakaaka mũtiitũ ũmwe hamwe. Gutarĩ saa, mbaara, gwaathĩrio, kana gũthiĩrio. Mũngĩ rĩrĩa rĩrĩ kũrĩ kũmara, na kũmara ta gũthiĩ kati nĩ ũndũ mwega mũno wa kũmalia.

faq.q: Kĩndũ tũkĩaka kana tũkĩrũmĩrwo kĩgaigwo kana kĩgatumwo?
faq.a: Aca. Gridi ĩgaakara webũ ĩno kaĩ. Ti ĩgaigwo, ti ĩgatumwo, kana ĩgatarwo, na ĩgathira rĩrĩa wakiga webũ. Angĩenda kũgikĩra, ĩrigĩrĩrĩrai gridi na mwake ndirikoni.

faq.q: Ngĩĩnja mũthinji harĩ ũtarĩ wega?
faq.a: Gutarĩ handũ hatarĩ wega. Gwaathania "Ĩngĩrĩra mũthinji wa mũgũthiro" nake mũtugo ũgacooka kũrĩ wee. Ũngĩngĩrĩra kĩmwe kĩmwe, na gũthiĩ kũngĩĩngĩrĩrwo.

faq.q: Andũ arĩa e na mũhumo wa rangi mamenyaga rangi ina ciothe?
faq.a: Nĩ ũndũ ũrĩa twathaniirie. Rangi o ĩmwe ina rĩtwa rĩayo rĩandĩkĩtwo, na mũthinji wayo wa kanini, kwa hinya kũrĩ rangi ti ndũhĩ ĩmwe ya kũmenyeka. Rangi ina twagerereririe nĩ mĩgwanĩro ya mĩhumo ya rangi ya ngũ na ngũ, na bluu na njano. Mũndũ ũrĩ na mũhumo wa rangi ti ndaagerie, nĩ ũndũ ũcio mwaraa mũtũmenyeria angĩ ĩrĩa ciothe ti ĩrĩa ĩrĩkana.

faq.q: Ndirikoni nĩ nene ũrĩa ũgatoĩka ũrĩ na kũnyaya, kana skrini nini?
faq.a: Ndirikoni o ĩmwe ĩrĩ na upana wa pikseli 56 angĩ. Gridi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mĩnene mũno nĩ ĩgaaga handũ kwayo rĩngĩ, ti nĩ ndirikoni kũnyiha.

faq.q: Kũrĩ toleo rĩa rũrĩrĩ?
faq.a: Ee. "Ĩrĩgiria gridi" nĩĩrĩgiria gridi ĩtarĩ kĩndũ rũrĩrĩ rũmwe, ina rangi ĩi na rĩtwa rĩayo, nĩguo mwake na ikaramu ĩĩrĩ. Nĩ ũrĩ mwerũ na mũcũ tondũ rangi o ĩmwe ina mũthinji wayo.

faq.q: Nĩ wa bure, na nĩ ĩndĩ ndĩ kwĩandĩkĩsha?
faq.a: Ee, nĩ ũhoro wa bure, na gũtarĩ akaunti, gũiyandikia kana gũkuua. Ũrahota kũmakĩrwo webũ-brauza ya thimũ, tebuleti kana kompiuta.

seated-toss.name: Kũrũmĩra wakaarĩte, kũũrania
seated-toss.seoTitle: Kũrũmĩra Wakaarĩte: Mũchezo wa Ndaaya Ĩrĩ Eerì
seated-toss.description: Andũ eerì mezani makwaria kũrũmĩra ndaaya ya mbegu mũgiriro mũnene, na mwandike wĩhi ũrĩ páipa. Gutarĩ ũrĩa ũgaathimĩrwo kana ũgathaaniwo. Ni wa bure kũgĩrũkia.
seated-toss.short: Kwaka mũgaano ũrĩ na ndaaya ya mbegu ũrũmĩrĩre mũgiriro mũnene, wĩhi ũrĩ páipa.
seated-toss.intro: Mũchezo wa kũrũmĩra ũrĩa ũgaatũmĩrwo nĩ andũ eerì ũrĩ wakaarĩte mezani. Wĩkaa gĩtarũ kĩrĩa kĩrĩ na mũgiriro mũnene mezani, na mũrũmĩre mũgwĩhi rũrĩrĩ rũrũmĩrĩre ndaaya ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na ũtuku mũnene, kana kaango ka mũgũ kaatuṅ'arĩtwo. O mũndũ wanyu akaandĩka wĩhi ũrĩa ũrũmĩrĩte ũgĩthiĩ mũgwano, nakĩ mũkaanyiĩrana mũrĩ mũgaathiaga. Gutarĩ ũrĩa ũgaathimĩrwo, gutarĩ ũrĩa ũgaatarwo skrini, na gutarĩ kĩndũ kĩgaigwo kana kĩgatumwo. Ũrĩ mbere, nĩ ũrĩa ũgwĩrĩra maũndũ ma ũgiriti: mbegu nini ĩrĩ na ũrĩa ũrĩ nĩ ũkĩrĩrĩ wa kũrĩa.
howTo: Ũrĩa maũndũ ma ũgiriti. Ũthuure ndaaya ĩrĩ na kĩtarĩ kĩgathikĩrwo, kana ũtuua kaango ka mũgũ kanyiihu.
Gwaathania "Ĩgiria kĩhĩtũ na wĩhi wa kũrũmĩra", na ũhiige ũrĩa mezani mũgĩtui.
Ũikaranĩre ũrĩ mũgiriri wamwe, ũrũmĩrane rĩmwe rĩmwe rĩrĩ gĩkĩkaa. Mũndũ ũmwe ũngĩ kũthiĩ.
Ndaaya ĩkaagwa harĩ ndirikoni, nĩ ũgũthigia ndirikoni ũrĩ mũthinji wayo, harĩ mũgiriro ũrĩa ũrĩ.
Ũrĩ mũthinji, mwĩtũ ũrĩa wahĩtũ mũgaatharaga hamwe, kana gwaathania Ruo nĩguo mũgĩkĩra.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ooneka ũhoro ũrĩa ũrĩ?" Ũmũhoro-ini nĩ wa kũgerera ũhoro ũrĩa ũrĩ.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ na ĩgũrũ kana mũtugo?
faq.a: Tiũ. Kũ kũrĩ saa, mũtugo, mũhiro wa ũhoro kana gũtũnga. Ũngĩ kũrũmĩra o hĩndĩ, na gũcooka ũgĩ kũndũ kwa mũcii nĩ ũndũ mwega wa gũcooka.

faq.q: Nĩ kwa ũhoro kũrũma gĩkapu kĩrĩ na mbeũ?
faq.a: Nĩ kũgĩgĩ ũhoro, na ũgĩ wa kũgĩrĩra. Rũmĩrĩrai gĩkapu kĩrĩ na mũcopo wa kũnoga kana mũtugo ũrĩ wa kũgĩa, tiũ mbeũ, mũceleli, kana ndũ nini ndĩ ĩrĩ ndĩ, ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hatari ya kũhũtĩra ana aanyinya na mũntu o wothe ũrĩa ũrĩtwaga ũndũ mũnwa. Kĩhũnda, rũmĩrĩra gĩkapu kĩrĩ gĩtũ ũgĩ gĩkĩ, ndũkarũme kwa mũntu, na mũndũ mũkuru aikare hakuhi.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩa gĩtarĩwa kana gĩkaigwa kũrĩa gĩkĩrĩ?
faq.a: Tiũ. Ũhoro wa ũtaarania nĩ kũrĩ wa rũrĩa rwa pampa, mĩrandĩ ĩrĩa mũgũtaarania ũndũ mwene. Ũhoro ũcio ndũkahũthĩra kũbara ndĩ, ndũkahũthĩra saa, na ndũkaigwa kana kũtũmwa kĩndũ.

faq.q: Nĩ atĩa angĩ mũntu ndaatanaga kũrũma, kana gĩkapu gĩgwa rĩrĩ rĩa pampa?
faq.a: Mũntu o wothe nĩ ũngĩ wa gũthiĩ, na gĩkapu kĩgwa rĩrĩ rĩa pampa gĩkaokwo nĩ mũgwatĩrĩre, ũndũ wa mũcii ũngĩ. Ndĩkathaario kĩndũ harĩ kĩo.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩrĩ pepa rĩrĩa rĩrandĩtwe?
faq.a: Pepa rĩmwe: kĩhĩndĩ kĩnene kĩrĩ na mĩtugo ĩtatũ ĩrĩa ĩtaitwo Hakuhi, Hagatĩ na Kũraya, mũtugo ũrĩ na kĩrĩti kĩrĩa kĩrĩ na kĩhĩndĩ kĩa mũntu o wothe, na mĩrĩ mĩnini ya gũtaara o kĩhĩndĩ, na mũstari wa ũtũngo wa hatari. Mĩtugo ĩrĩ ĩrĩ kũrĩ ĩtaitwo ũhoro, nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũgĩĩka na rangi nyeusi na ndirĩ.

faq.q: Nĩ gĩtũ kĩrĩ ũgĩ, na nĩ ũkĩ ũkĩrĩrĩrwa?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ gĩtũ, na tiũ akaunti, ũndũ wa kwandĩkĩsa kana gũkũra. Nĩĩ gũkorwa kĩrĩ ũgĩ wa webu harĩ thimũ, tabuleti kana kompiuta.

seasonal-pack.name: Pakĩti ya mĩgaathĩ ya mwaka
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Pakĩti ya Mĩgaathĩ ya Mwaka: Mĩgaathĩ ya Pepa ĩrĩa Rĩrandĩtwa
seasonal-pack.h1: Pakĩti ya Mĩgaathĩ ya Mwaka: Mĩgaathĩ Ĩtatũ ya Pepa Mwaka Wothe
seasonal-pack.description: Mĩgaathĩ ĩtatũ ĩnini ĩrĩa ĩrandĩtwa ya ndagĩka, ya mwaka wa Themba, Mũthenya, Mũthono kana Mũthenya wa Rũgĩtĩ: ũkĩnganĩrie mĩthemba, ũrũme ũrĩa ũtariganaga, na ũrangĩ ũhoro. Thuura mwaka, kana ũike mũthenya wa gũcooka. Nĩ gĩtũ gũrandithwo.
seasonal-pack.short: Mĩgaathĩ ĩtatũ ĩrĩa ĩrandĩtwa ya mwaka ũrĩa ũthuurĩte, kana mũthenya wa gũcooka.
seasonal-pack.players: Ndĩrĩ o cionthe, mũntu ũmwe kana hamwe
seasonal-pack.intro: Thuura mwaka, na ũkĩona mĩgaathĩ ĩtatũ ĩnini ya pepa ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mĩhaandĩro ya mwaka ũcio: mĩtugo ĩrĩ mĩrĩ ya kũngiha na mĩstari, mũtugo ũrĩ wa ũnene wa ĩna ya kũgiria ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ ta ĩngĩ, na mũhaandĩro wa kũrangĩa. Nĩũrandithaga pepa ĩmwe, ĩndĩ ũgaakorwo ũgĩ ũmwe, ĩrĩ mbere kana ĩtatũ, ũkĩ ũkĩgwatĩra ũhoro wa gĩkĩ. Ũgĩthuura "Ũmũthenya ũnũ nĩ mũthenya wa gũcooka" ũkĩrĩrĩra, ndĩkoĩ gĩkĩ kĩrĩa gĩkorwo.
howTo: Thuura mwaka, kana thuura "Ũmũthenya ũnũ nĩ mũthenya wa gũcooka".
Ngarĩria mĩgaathĩ ĩtatũ, ĩndĩ ũkanyiita "Randithia pakĩti ya mwaka ũyũ".
Korwo ũmwe, ĩrĩ mbere kana ĩtatũ, ũkĩ ũkĩgwatĩra ũhoro wa gĩkĩ.
Ngiha mĩhaandĩro ĩrĩa ĩrĩ ta ĩngĩ na mũstari, ũcooke ũrũme ũrĩa ũtariganaga, na ũrangĩe mũhaandĩro mũnene.
Ũgaacooka o hĩndĩ ũrĩa wendaga. Mũthenya wa gũcooka nao nĩ mũthenya mwega.
tips: Tandĩka na mĩgaathĩ ĩrĩa ĩgaaga ũrĩa ũrĩ ũmũthenya ũyũ. Ĩmwe nĩ ĩngĩ.
Ũgĩkaria rĩĩtwa rĩa o mũhaandĩro ũkĩ ũrĩ mwerũ, angĩ nĩ ũkĩ.
Rũmĩrĩrai mĩrangi ya ndagĩka kana ya pencil. Rangi o yothe nĩ ĩrega.
Ĩka pepa rĩu ũmũthenya ũngĩ, kana rĩtiga.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ saa kana ĩgũrũ?
faq.a: Tiũ. Kũ kũrĩ saa, ĩgũrũ, mũhiro wa ũhoro kana gũtũnga. Ũngĩ kũrũmĩra o hĩndĩ, na gũcooka ũgĩ kũndũ kwa mũcii nĩ ũndũ mwega wa gũcooka.

faq.q: Kĩhĩndĩ kĩrĩ kĩmenyaga mwaka ũrĩa ũrĩ?
faq.a: Tiũ. Wee nĩ ũthuuraga mwaka. Kĩhĩndĩ gĩtarorĩraga mũthenya kana gĩkaro gĩaku.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ ĩgũrũ kana kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩrĩ kĩĩrĩ?
faq.a: Tiũ. Kĩndũ o gĩothe gĩtarĩ ũhoro wa saa, ĩgũrũ kana gĩtarorwo kĩrĩ ũgĩ wa ũrĩa, na tiũ mĩcooka ĩrĩa ĩtũngwo. O mũgaathĩ nĩ ũhoro wa gũtarĩrĩra, gũkĩrĩrĩra mũgaathĩ, kũngiha, kũcooka kana kũrangĩa.

faq.q: Nĩ atĩa angĩ mũndũ o wothe ndaendaga mĩgaathĩ ũmũthenya ũyũ?
faq.a: Thuura "Ũmũthenya ũnũ nĩ mũthenya wa gũcooka". Kĩhĩndĩ gĩrĩ kũonania mũstari mũmwe wa gũtũũla, na tiũ kĩndũ kĩrĩa gĩrandithwo kana gĩkorwo.

faq.q: Kũ kũrĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩrĩ pepa rĩrĩa rĩrandĩtwe?
faq.a: Pepa rĩmwe rĩa mwaka ũrĩa wathuura: mĩgaathĩ yaro ĩtatũ, o ĩrĩ na mũstari mũnini wa ũndũ wa gũĩka, na mũstari ũrĩa ũgwetaga ũngĩ ũrĩa ũgaakorwo, ĩrĩ mbere, ĩtatũ kana ũmwe.

faq.q: Nĩ gĩtũ kĩrĩ ũgĩ, na nĩ ũkĩ ũkĩrĩrĩrwa?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ gĩtũ, na tiũ akaunti, ũndũ wa kwandĩkĩsa kana gũkũra. Nĩĩ gũkorwa kĩrĩ ũgĩ wa webu harĩ thimũ, tabuleti kana kompiuta.

decorate-a-card.name: Ũrembe kaadi hamwe
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Ũrembe Kaadi Hamwe: Kaadi ya Ũtumwa ya Pepa ĩrĩa Rĩrandĩtwa
decorate-a-card.h1: Ũrembe Kaadi Hamwe: Ĩka Ĩmwe Nĩ Mũndũ Ũmwe
decorate-a-card.description: Andũ eerĩ mamũrembe kaadi ya ũtumwa ĩrĩa ĩrandĩtwe, ya ũtukũ wa kuuma, ũgwaĩ wa gĩtũ kana ũndũ o wothe, ĩndĩ mũandike ũhoro kũrĩ mũgongo hamwe. Ndagĩka kana pen tu. Tiũ saa wala ĩgũrũ. Nĩ gĩtũ gũrandithwo.
decorate-a-card.short: Rembe kaadi ya ũtumwa ĩrĩa ĩrandĩtwe hamwe.
decorate-a-card.intro: Ũmũgaathĩ wa gũĩka wa andũ eerĩ, ũrĩa mũkĩrĩgwo mũrĩ mamwe. Nĩũrandithaga pepa rĩmwe, rĩkĩgũkũnja rĩgaatuma kaadi. Thuura ũndũ wa gũtũũla, ta ũtukũ wa kuuma kana ũgwaĩ wa gĩtũ, ĩndĩ urembe mbere ya kaadi ũkĩ ũrĩ na ciĩ ciayo. Ĩndĩ andika ũhoro kũrĩ mũgongo, mũkĩandikaga hamwe kana mũntu ũmwe agatandika ũrĩa ũngĩ ũgwaga. Rũmĩrĩrai ndagĩka, ndagĩka ya rangi kana pen ya fiĩti. Tiũ kaadi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ ĩrĩ sawa, na tiũ kĩndũ kĩrĩa gĩtarĩwa saa, gĩkaigwa kana gĩtũmwa.
howTo: Thura mũthenya wa gũkĩrĩra, kuo ũgwe “Icapa kaadi”.
Kũnja rũrũri rũrũ kũgerĩra mũstari ũrĩ na mĩcene, nĩguo mbere ĩrĩ nja.
Mũndũ ũmwe nĩ ekũtaka mbere, na ũngĩ nĩ ekũtaka nyuma, kana mũgĩĩtĩka upande ũmwe.
Mũandikaga ũhoro hamwe. Mũndũ ũmwe nĩ ekwandĩka, na ũngĩ nĩ akwaria maneno.
Rekaga rĩrĩa wenda. Kaadi rahisi nĩ ya mwega ta ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mĩtĩ mĩingĩ.
tips: Tandĩkaga maneno mbere, ĩrĩ na ũgĩongerera mahiũ, mĩcene kana mĩtĩ mĩrĩa mĩgĩ, rĩmwe rĩmwe.
Angĩ mũndũ ndakenda gũkũra, nĩ ekũhũra rangi kana kwandĩka ũhoro.
Gwaria ũrĩa wenda mũhĩtĩ wa mũndũ ũngĩ, ti kũũra kana nĩ mwega.
Ika kaadi handũ harĩa nĩ ĩgwĩtwa, kana ĩikĩrwo mezani rĩu.

faq.q: Nĩ kwarĩ na mũgiro kana ndaraca?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtirĩ saa, ndaraca, mũtwe wa mĩhaka kana gũtharara. Nĩ wakĩnyĩka o hĩndĩ, na gũkeka tĩĩ ni njĩra mwega ya gũkĩrĩra.

faq.q: Nĩ tũkeenda gĩamba, mĩcio kana mĩhiri?
faq.a: Aca. Kĩrĩmĩ, mĩraa ya mĩcene kana kalama ya mĩtĩ nĩ yonanĩ. Gũtirĩ kũgerĩra, gũgamba kana gũtũmĩra.

faq.q: Tũkĩnyĩkĩra kaadi ya mũthenya ũtarĩ kwa rũrĩrĩ?
faq.a: Thura “Ti ũhoro wa mũthenya” na ũkwandĩka maneno maaku mbere ya kaadi, kana ũtaka kaadi ũtarĩ mũthenya wowe.

faq.q: Nĩ kwarĩ gĩtwa gĩgerĩrwo, gĩgeretwo kana gĩgwiciwo kwa skirini?
faq.a: Aca. Ukurasa wa wega wonanĩ kaadi na mahinda ma mĩhĩgĩ. Gũtirĩ kũrũmanĩrwo, kũgerwo kana kũgeciwo, na gũtirĩ kaadi ĩrĩ ya kũmĩĩo.

faq.q: Nĩ kĩ kĩ kĩrĩ kĩ pepa rĩrĩa rĩcapiwe?
faq.a: Ukurasa ũmwe: kaadi ĩrĩ nyiru, ĩrĩ na maneno ma mũthenya na kĩhĩkĩo kĩrahisi mbere, na mĩtĩ ya ũhoro na ya Kuuma kwa Nyuma. Mĩhaho ya andũ eerĩ ĩrĩ capiwe thĩ.

faq.q: Nĩ bure, na nĩ ĩngĩrĩra kwĩandĩkĩsha?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ bure, na gũtirĩ akaunti, kwandĩkĩsha kana kũhurũra. Nĩ ũgwĩka kuuma kwa browser ya simu, tablet kana kompyuta.

find-together.name: Thaitha hamwe
find-together.seoTitle: Thaitha Hamwe: Andũ Eerĩ Mahaitha Mahaaro Maheana
find-together.h1: Thaitha Hamwe: Andũ Eerĩ, Kĩhenya Kĩmwe
find-together.description: Andũ eerĩ maahaana skirini ĩmwe na mahinda maahindũra kaadi cia mĩhĩgĩ eerĩ, mahaitha mahaaro. Mahaaro mahaithio hamwe na kũbaraga kwa kĩlĩ kĩmwe kĩa hamwe. Ni bure kwĩhĩa, tĩ na saa kana mbeko.
find-together.short: Hindũra na mũndũ ũrĩ hakuhĩ nawe ũthaithe mahaaro ma mĩhĩgĩ.
find-together.intro: Kaadi nĩ cigeranagĩrĩra mĩhĩgĩ yacio, kana nĩ ũgwĩka kũcirũmĩra thĩ. Hĩndĩ yaku ũhindũraga kaadi ĩrĩ eerĩ. Angĩ nĩ mahaithio, nĩ mũthaitha hamwe, na hĩndĩ ĩgaagĩra. Angĩ nĩ mahaaro, nĩ makaaga nyiru hĩnĩ tĩ ũgwĩka “Mahindũre”, nĩguo mũtĩkĩrĩrĩrĩ hamwe. Ũgwĩka gĩkaĩ wa gũtiga o hĩndĩ. Kĩbarakaro kĩrĩ ũrũ nĩ kĩ kũhaa, nĩ mahaaro mahaithio hamwe.
howTo: Thura kaadi ingĩ ũgwĩka. Kaadi itandatũ, mahaaro matatũ, nĩ mũthenya mwega wa kũtangĩrĩra.
Skirini ĩgwonania ũhindũraga, ĩrĩ na kĩrĩ kĩ mũndũ wa mbere na kĩ kaaro kĩa mũndũ wa keerĩ.
Hindũra kaadi eerĩ, ũmwe ũmwe. Angĩ mahaithio, nĩ mũthaitha hamwe.
Angĩ nĩ mahaaro, ũgwĩka “Mahindũre” hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mwathĩĩĩ. Hĩndĩ ĩgaagĩra ĩkahinda mũndũ ũngĩ.
Mũndũ o wothe nĩ ekũgwĩka “Ruga” hĩndĩ ĩrĩa wenda. Ũgwĩka “Tangĩrĩra rĩngĩ” kaadi nyingĩ, kana “Reka” nĩguo ũcoke.
tips: Ikarĩra hakuhĩ na nĩguo mũgwĩta mĩhĩgĩ hamwe: “Gĩkombe kĩa cai. Nĩ wendaga ũriũ ũkĩnyuĩra cai yaku?”
Rekaga mũndũ ũrĩ kũrĩrĩrwo nĩ ũhĩgĩ ahindũre, angĩ nĩ akĩgĩĩa. Ũmwĩrĩre na kĩ kĩ ũcoke.
Thura “Kaadi ci ibũrĩ” angĩ mũkenda gũhindũra kaadi nĩguo mũone mĩhĩgĩ.
Mũndũ ũrĩ na mũkĩo wa kũgaya nĩ ekwĩgwĩka kwaga mahaithio rĩrĩa wenda. Mahaaro maahaithio hamwe.

faq.q: Nĩ kwarĩ mũndũ wa kũnyiha, saa kana mbeko?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtirĩ mũndũ wa kũnyiha, nĩ mũthaitha mahaaro hamwe. Gũtirĩ saa, mbeko kana kũbarĩra makosa. Kĩbarakaro nĩ gĩtwa gĩa mahaaro mahaithio hamwe, na nĩ ũgwĩka kũgĩa rĩrĩa wenda.

faq.q: Nĩ tũkeenda kũkumbũka mahinda ma mĩhĩgĩ?
faq.a: Aca. Mũhaaro ũtangĩrĩra na mĩhĩgĩ yothe ĩrĩ nyiru. Kaadi ciĩ thĩ, nĩ mũgwĩrĩra mũrĩ na mũndũ ũngĩ ũrĩa mwaonĩte, kana mũgwĩka kũciindĩrĩrĩra.

faq.q: Kĩ kĩĩgwa angĩ kaadi eerĩ ti ĩmwe?
faq.a: Ĩgwaga nyiru, nĩguo mũone ũmwe ũmwe, nĩ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mwendaga. Tĩ kaadi ĩngĩ kwĩhindũrĩra. Rĩrĩa mũgwĩka, ũgwĩka “Mahindũre”, nayo hĩndĩ ĩkahinda mũndũ ũngĩ.

faq.q: Mũhaaro ũrĩa tũgwĩka nĩ wĩcũũrwo kana nĩ wĩtũmĩrwo?
faq.a: Aca. Kaadi icigaa ukurasa ũyu tu. Tĩ mũhaaro ũcũũrwo, ũtũmwo kana ũbarĩrwo, na ũgathira rĩrĩa ũkĩnyĩka ukurasa.

faq.q: Kaadi nĩ nene ũgerĩ kũnyiha gĩtũ kana skirini nini?
faq.a: Kaadi o yothe nĩ nene ndaaĩ 64 pixel, na ĩrĩ nene ũgerĩ skirini ĩrĩ. Andũ mahanda na ndero ya kũrũmania mahurũra kaadi o yothe na kĩmwe, nĩ mũthenya wayo na mĩhĩgĩ yayo.

faq.q: Nĩ bure, na nĩ ĩngĩrĩra kwĩandĩkĩsha?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ bure, na gũtirĩ akaunti, kwandĩkĩsha kana kũhurũra. Nĩ ũgwĩka kuuma kwa browser ya simu, tablet kana kompyuta.

story-dice.name: Ndaai cia hadithi
story-dice.seoTitle: Ndaai cia Hadithi: Mchezo wa Kuhadithia kwa Picha
story-dice.h1: Ndaai cia Hadithi: Hadithia ukitumia Picha
story-dice.description: Ndaai cia picha tatũ kana inè cia kuhadithia, o ũcio mũhaatagĩrĩrwo. Gũtirĩ gũthoma, gũtirĩ jibu ĩrĩ ya kwĩgwĩĩa, gũtirĩ saa wala mbeko. Hindũra rĩngĩ, kana reka. Ni bure kwĩhĩa na kũcapa.
story-dice.short: Hindũra ndaai cia picha na mũhadithie hamwe, o njĩra yoothe.
story-dice.players: Andũ 2 kana erĩ, kana mũndũ mũkũrũ na mwana
story-dice.intro: Mĩhaka 3 kana 4 ĩrĩ ta mĩrĩmo ya mũthĩĩ, ĩgaragarwo. Hamwe, andũ mwaaka hadithi ĩrĩa ĩtumĩĩra mĩhaka ĩyo, mũthenya ũtarĩ mũtindo. Hadithi ĩngĩ ĩrĩ ĩgĩ-ĩ kana ĩngĩ ĩrĩ ĩmwe, ĩngĩ ĩgĩa gĩtĩa, kana ĩgĩa gĩa ĩrĩ-na-ĩ ũhoro wa mũthenya. Gũtirĩ hadithi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ sahihi, na gũtirĩ mũntu ũtegĩrĩirwo gũĩta kana gũkumbuka kĩndũ. Thinjai “Rĩngĩrĩria” mĩhaka mĩngĩ, na mũntu o wothe nĩ ekũgwetĩka gũthiĩ.
howTo: Thura mĩhaka 3 kana 4. Mĩhaka 3 nĩyo ĩrĩa ĩrahoro.
Rorai mĩhaka hamwe. Thinjai ĩmwe ũrĩa mwendaga gũtangĩrĩria nayo.
Ĩrai hadithi ĩtumĩĩra mĩhaka, o mũntu akĩ-ĩra ndĩ-ĩ ĩrĩ mũthenya. Ĩrĩ ĩmwe ya ngero nĩ ĩtosha.
Mũntu o wothe nĩ ekũgwetĩka gũthiĩ. Thinjai “Rega” na mũntu ũngĩ akaambĩrĩrie.
Thinjai “Rĩngĩrĩria” ũkĩ mĩhaka mĩngĩ ũrĩa mwendaga, kana thinjai Pumzika ũkĩ mwagĩrĩrĩre.
tips: Ũũriĩre ũtũũria kũrĩa gũtegĩrĩra mũndũ ũngĩ: “Kanua mwathĩ ũmbũrĩra nĩ ũkaĩ?”
Ongerai kĩndũ kĩrĩa mũntu ũũrĩ aĩtĩte, mũtarĩ gwaathĩrĩria. Hadithi ĩrĩa yothe nĩ ĩrĩ ũrĩ.
Hadithi nĩ ũkaĩrĩra gĩkumbũrũko kĩa ũhoro. Mĩhaka nĩ ĩtangĩrĩria mwega wa gũĩta.

faq.q: Kũrĩ ngwa ya thaa kana mũhĩgo?
faq.a: Tiĩ. Gũtirĩ ngwa ya thaa, mũhĩgo, kana gũkagĩrĩra. Nĩũngĩ kũhoya gĩthĩĩ o rĩrĩa, na gũkoma kĩrĩa kĩgwĩtĩka nĩ ũndũ mwega wa gũthiĩra.

faq.q: Nĩ ngĩgwĩrĩka kũbaza kana kwĩta mĩhaka?
faq.a: Tiĩ. Mchezo ũrĩ ũkĩgwĩta na mĩhaka yoothe. Andũ nĩ mekũthuĩa, kwĩra, kana kwaria kĩrĩa mĩhaka ĩyo ĩmakĩrĩtagĩrĩra. Gũtirĩ mũntu ũtegĩrĩirwo gũĩta kana gũkumbuka kĩndũ.

faq.q: Nĩ atĩa angĩ ũtarĩ mwendo wa gũthiĩ?
faq.a: Nĩ ekũgwetĩka gũrega o rĩrĩa, ũtarĩ kĩtũmo gĩa gwĩbanĩria. Mchezo nĩ wathĩĩrĩra, na mũntu ũngĩ akaambĩrĩrie kana mũhaka mũngĩ ũthuĩwo.

faq.q: Kũrĩ tooro ya mũhĩrĩ wa mpapura?
faq.a: Ĩĩ. Rũtĩo rũmwe rwa mpapura rwĩ na mĩhaka 16 ĩtarĩ ĩtarĩ, ĩrĩ mĩtĩ 4. Thura mũtĩ ũmwe, kana ũkaate mĩhaka ũrĩ ũgĩĩ ũgũthura kuuma rũndũ rwa mĩhaka.

faq.q: Nĩ bure, na nĩ ngĩĩ ũgwĩandĩkĩsha?
faq.a: Ĩĩ, nĩ bure, na gũtirĩ akaunti, gwandĩkĩsha, kana kũruta. Nĩ ũrĩ kwa mũtandaza wa wĩbu kwa ndũme, kĩbao kana kompyuta.

word-and-picture-pairs.description: Gerania ngambo cia Kĩngereza na mĩhaka yacho, na ũigue kĩgambo kĩrĩa kĩothe kĩrĩ soma. Mĩhaka nĩ ĩkaaga ĩonekaga, gũtirĩ thaa, tũmbĩrĩ, kana kũbara mĩgerĩ. Ũrĩ bure gwĩcheza na gwĩtĩa.

word-and-picture-pairs.players: Mũntu mũkuru ũmwe, kana famĩlia ĩcheza ĩrĩ hamwe
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Mĩhaka 4 kana 6 nĩ ĩgaragarwo, na ngambo cia Kĩngereza cia mĩhaka ĩyo ĩrĩ mũthenya ũngĩ. Thinjai kĩgambo, ũkĩ mũhaka wakĩ ũrĩa kĩrĩ ũmenyeki, kana thinjai mũhaka, ũkĩ kĩgambo kĩrĩa kĩrĩ nao. Ĩrĩ ĩmwe ĩrĩ yakwa ĩkaaga na mũhango mũnene, na kĩgambo “Gwakanĩrĩka”. Thinjai “Ũigue” ũrĩ hakuhi na kĩgambo gĩothe kũigua kĩrĩa kĩgwĩtĩka. Gũtirĩ thaa wala ũtaaga, na gĩthinja kĩrĩa gĩtakuma gĩgũũka gĩthere.
howTo: Thura mĩhaka 4 kana 6. Mĩhaka 4 nĩyo ĩrĩa ĩrahoro.
Thinjai kĩgambo, ĩndĩ mũhaka ũrĩa kĩrĩ kĩĩta. Kana thinjai mũhaka mbere, ĩndĩ kĩgambo kĩrĩa kĩrĩ nao.

Thinjai “Ũigue” hakuhi na kĩgambo kũkĩigua, kana kwa ndũme yanyu ĩrĩ ũkĩmenya gũĩta.
Thinjai “Mĩhaka mĩngĩ” nĩ wa mĩhaka ĩngĩ, kana “Tangĩrĩria rĩngĩ” nĩ wa kũũrania ĩrĩ yothe. “Cookia” nĩ ya kũcookia ĩrĩ ĩrĩa ya mbere.
tips: Ĩrai ngambo ĩrĩa ĩothe hamwe mbere ya gũĩrania, na mũjadiliane kuuma mũhaka.
Famĩlia nĩ ĩkagĩrĩra gũthiĩ, o mũntu akĩthura kĩgambo kana mũhaka ũmwe mũthenya ũmwe.
Tangĩrĩria na ngambo ũrĩa mũmenyĩte, na ũreke ĩngĩ ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ ĩrĩ mũthenya ũngĩ.

faq.q: Nĩ kwa ngai ya ciana?
faq.a: Nĩ ya andũ akuru marĩa marutaga kana mararuta gũgerania ngambo cia Kĩngereza, na famĩlia ĩcheza ĩrĩ hamwe. Gũtirĩ nĩ ya ciana.

faq.q: Nĩ atĩa kĩhiĩ kĩrĩ ndũme yakwa ũtaigua mĩhaka?
faq.a: Mũhango wa “Ũigue” nĩ wa kũmbĩrĩria sauti ĩrĩa kĩbaĩro gĩa nyũmba yaku kĩrĩ nayo. Ũhoro kĩbaĩro gĩtarĩ kwaria, mũhango ndũkaonekana, na mchezo nĩ ũthiĩra ndũ ũrĩa ũtarĩ.

faq.a: Ĩĩ. Rũtĩo rũmwe rwa mpapura rwĩ na mĩhaka 6 na ngambo cia 6, rwa kũcookia kana kũhandĩkania na mũcari.

sort-together.name: Mũranĩrai hamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Gwaanga: Gwaanga Hamwe Nĩ Andũ Akũrũ
sort-together.h1: Mũranĩrai Hamwe: Ũndũ wa Kũmũrania Mbica
sort-together.description: Thinjai mũhaka, ũkĩ gĩkapu kĩrĩa kĩrĩ nao: jikoni kana mũgũnda, mĩtunda kana nyamu. Ni mchezo wa gwaanga ũtũũrĩte na ũrĩ bure kwa andũ akũrũ na famĩlia.
sort-together.short: Ĩkĩra o mbica gĩkabu-inĩ gĩakĩo: kĩgĩna-inĩ kana mũgũnda-inĩ, na mangĩ maingĩ.
sort-together.intro: Kũmũrania maũndũ nĩ wĩra ũyũĩkĩte na ũrehagĩre ngoro gĩkeno o mũthenya, ta kũiga indo cia thoko wega kana kũbanga thogithi. Hinyĩrĩria mbica, ũcoke ũhinyĩrĩrie gĩkabu kĩrĩa ĩgwĩkĩrwo. Gũtirĩ kũhiũha na gũtirĩ mahĩtia.

Angĩkorwo ĩgĩrĩire gĩkabu-inĩ kĩrĩa kĩngĩ, ithako rĩonanagia ũhoro ũcio na njĩra ya ũhooreri na rĩgeterera.
Mbica ciothe ciamũranio, rorai thĩinĩ wa ikabu icio hamwe.

Hũthĩrai mbica ta kĩambĩrĩria gĩa kwaria: "Nĩ kĩĩ wahandĩte mũgũnda-inĩ waku?"
Kũmũrania indo cia kũhũthĩra cia biũ, ta thihaani na marũma kana thithiro kũringana na rangi, nĩ ũndũ mwega mũno wa kũhũthĩra mũtegũkorwo mbere ya kĩara kĩa thimũ.

faq.q: Hihi nĩ kũrĩ thaa kana ũtari wa pointi?
faq.a: Aca. Gũtirĩ thaa, pointi, kĩndũ gĩa gũtara mathiĩro, kana kũhũũrwo. No mũtige rĩrĩa rĩothe mwendete, o na kũtigĩrĩria gatagatĩ nĩ njĩra njega biũ ya kũrĩkĩa.

faq.q: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmaga tũmũranie?
faq.a: Andũ aingĩ nĩ mendete kũmũrania indo tondũ kũiguĩkaga ta wĩra wa bata na ũyũĩkĩte. Ningĩ nĩ ũhũthũ kwaranĩria ũhoro wa mbica icio o mũgĩthiĩ na mbere.

finish-the-saying.short: Rĩkĩriai thimo iria mũũĩ hamwe, mũcoke mwarĩrie ũhoro wacio.

O karatathi koonanagia thimo ĩĩkĩte kũmenyeka ĩtegũkorwo na kiugo kĩa mũico, mathuuro matatũ, hamwe na kabatĩ kĩa "Onania kĩrĩkĩrĩro". Thutha wa kĩrĩkĩrĩro kuoneka, kĩũria kĩhooreri nĩ gĩtũmaga mũgĩe na ndeereti njega.
howTo: Thomai thimo ĩyo na mũgambo mũnene hamwe.
Hinyĩrĩria kiugo kĩrĩa kĩrĩmĩrĩkia, kana ũhinyĩrĩrie "Onania kĩrĩkĩrĩro".
Thomai thimo ĩyo yothe rĩngĩ na mwarĩrie ũhoro wayo kũringana na kĩũria kĩu.
Hinyĩrĩria "Thimo ĩrĩa ĩrũmĩrĩire" rĩrĩa mwahaarĩrĩka.
tips: Thoma kahora na ũtige kamwanya kanini mbere ya kiugo kĩa mũico. Kaingĩ andũ nĩ makĩugaga o ũtanarĩkĩa.
Mũndũ angĩheana kĩrĩkĩrĩro kĩngĩ ngũrani, kĩkenerei. Thimo imwe nĩ ikoragwo na mĩario ĩngĩ kũringana na mĩhĩrĩga kana icigo ciacio.
Thĩinĩ wa gĩkundi, mũndũ ũmwe athomaga na andũ arĩa angĩ othe makamĩrĩkĩria hamwe.

word-search.description: Gũtaarĩra ngambo mĩrĩ mĩnene ĩrĩ bure kwa andũ akũrũ na famĩlia. Ngambo nyingĩ nĩ ndĩ, mĩhandĩo mĩnene, ngambo cia mũcari na cia gĩthaka tu. Cheza mtandaoni kana gũcookia.
word-search.short: Ndemwa nene, ciugo nini, kuuma mwena kũrĩ mwena na igũrũ gũthiĩ thĩ tu. O na no ũcabe.
word-search.intro: Kanyomoko kanini karĩ na ndemwa nene na ciugo nini tu, ciothe ithomagwo kuuma mwena kũrĩ mwena kana igũrũ gũthiĩ thĩ. Hũnya ndemwa ya mbere ya kiugo, ũcoke ũhũnye ndemwa yakĩo ya mũthia. Nĩ wendete karatathi? Caba ithaako rĩerũ o na kũhũnya rĩmwe tu.

Hũnya ndemwa ya mbere ya kiugo, ũcoke ũhũnye ndemwa yakĩo ya mũthia.
Kiugo kĩrĩa kĩooneka nĩ gĩkũhithũrio na kĩgathario kuuma mũkũkũ-inĩ.

Karatathi-inĩ, karamu kanene ka rangi nĩ kahũthũ kũnyita gũkĩra karamu ga gĩtĩ.

coloring.description: Mabuthĩ mahũthũ ma andũ agima ma gũhaka rangi marĩ na kũndũ kũnene: hũnya rangi, ũcoke ũhũnye mbica. Gũtirĩ gĩtitiro, gũtirĩ rangi mũhĩtanu, na o ithangu no rĩcabwo gwa tũhũ.
coloring.short: Hũnya rangi, ũcoke ũhũnye gĩcunjĩ kĩa mbica. O na no ũcabe mabuthĩ maya.
coloring.intro: Mabuthĩ marĩ na mbica hũthũ na nene: ihũa rĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũngũ, nyũmba, gĩkombe kĩa caai, ngĩũngũhũ, na marikabu. Hũnya rangi, ũcoke ũhũnye gĩcunjĩ kĩa mbica nĩguo ũkĩiyũrie rangi. Gũtirĩ rangi o na ũmwe mũhĩtanu.
howTo: Thuura ithangu.
Hũnya rangi. O rangi nĩ wandĩkĩtwo rĩĩtwa rĩaguo igũrũ rĩaguo.
Hũnya gĩcunjĩ kĩa mbica nĩguo ũkĩiyũrie rangi ũcio.
No ũcenjie meciria hĩndĩ o yothe na kũhaka rangi ũngĩ rĩngĩ.
Hũnya "Caba ithangu rĩrĩ" nĩguo wone ithangu rĩtarĩ ihake ũhake na karamu kana rangi.
tips: Heana marangi merĩ tu ma gũthuura handũ ha marangi mothe angĩkorwo gũthuura kũrotetheka nĩ kũritũha.
Mĩtĩ ya rangi wa barũbũ na riũa rĩa buruu nĩ mikĩrĩre ngoro. Ũndũ ũrĩa ũrendekana nĩ gũkenera rangi, ti gũkorwo maũndũ me ma biũ.
Mabuthĩ marĩa macabĩtwo nĩ mega mũno ũkĩhũthĩra makara manene ma rangi, tondũ nĩ mahũthũ kũnyita moko-inĩ.
